mapper.sql: CASE WHEN latest.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_SUBMITTED' WHEN latest.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING_REVIEW' WHEN latest.status = 'APPLIED' AND latest.audit_required = false THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' WHEN latest.status = 'APPLIED' AND latest.audit_required = true THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN latest.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, service, version, method, internal_class, internal_method FROM catalog_api_draft WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND (name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR service LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR method LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR CONCAT(service, '.', method) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR internal_class LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY name, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM catalog_category WHERE enabled=true AND name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY name,id
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_api_draft SET name=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.name} END, category=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.category} END, owner=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.owner} END, protocol=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.protocol} END, draft_revision=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.draftRevision} END, dubbo_connection_id=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.dubboConnectionId} END, dubbo_connection_revision=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.dubboConnectionRevision} END, internal_class=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.internalClass} END, internal_method=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.internalMethod} END, mcp_tool_enabled=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.mcpToolEnabled} END, definition_json=CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.definitionJson} END WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND ( (id=#{d.id} AND draft_revision=#{d.draftRevision}-1) )

UPDATE catalog_api_draft SET name = #{draft.name}, category = #{draft.category}, owner = #{draft.owner}, protocol = #{draft.protocol}, draft_revision = #{draft.draftRevision}, definition_json = #{draft.definitionJson}, dubbo_connection_id = #{draft.dubboConnectionId}, dubbo_connection_revision = #{draft.dubboConnectionRevision}, internal_class = #{draft.internalClass}, internal_method = #{draft.internalMethod}, mcp_tool_enabled = #{draft.mcpToolEnabled} WHERE environment_id=#{draft.environmentId} AND id = #{draft.id} AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision}
